```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(scales)
library(ggh4x)
library(viridis)

file_sources <- list.files(here("scripts"), pattern = "*.R$", full.names = TRUE)
invisible(lapply(file_sources, source))

base_theme <- theme_minimal(base_size = 9) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(colour = "grey50", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.4),
    axis.ticks = element_line(colour = "grey50"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 7),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 8),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 8),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 7),
    panel.spacing.x = unit(0.8, "lines"),
    panel.spacing.y = unit(0.8, "lines")
  )

square_theme <- theme(aspect.ratio = 1)

add_masks <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    mutate(
      oxygen_exclusion = as.logical(round(as.numeric(oxygen_exclusion))),
      energetic_exclusion = as.logical(round(as.numeric(energetic_exclusion))),
      energetic_exclusion = if_else(is.na(energetic_exclusion), FALSE, energetic_exclusion),
      excl_o2 = oxygen_exclusion,
      excl_e = !excl_o2 & energetic_exclusion
    )
}

plot_masked <- function(df, x, y, z, palette = c("blue", "viridis", "green", "purple", "red"),
                        fill_title = "", limits = NULL) {
  palette <- match.arg(palette)

  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = .data[[x]], y = .data[[y]])) +
    geom_raster(data = df %>% filter(!excl_o2, !excl_e), aes(fill = .data[[z]]), interpolate = TRUE) +
    geom_raster(data = df %>% filter(excl_e), fill = "grey70", interpolate = TRUE) +
    geom_raster(data = df %>% filter(excl_o2), fill = "black", interpolate = TRUE)

  if (palette == "blue") p <- p + scale_fill_gradient(low = "#f7fbff", high = "#2171b5", name = fill_title, limits = limits, oob = squish, na.value = "black")
  if (palette == "viridis") p <- p + scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "D", name = fill_title, limits = limits, oob = squish, na.value = "black")
  if (palette == "green") p <- p + scale_fill_gradient(low = "#f7fcf5", high = "#238b45", name = fill_title, limits = limits, oob = squish, na.value = "black")
  if (palette == "purple") p <- p + scale_fill_gradient(low = "#fcfbfd", high = "#6a51a3", name = fill_title, limits = limits, oob = squish, na.value = "black")
  if (palette == "red") p <- p + scale_fill_gradient(low = "#fff5f0", high = "#cb181d", name = fill_title, limits = limits, oob = squish, na.value = "black")

  p + base_theme + square_theme
}

tr <- list(
  a_a = 80, b_R = 0.85,
  a_g = 3, hm = 1,
  f_m = 0.1, b_m = 0.75,
  a_e = 200, b_e = 2 / 3,
  a_c = 60, b_c = 0.75,
  epsAssim = 0.7, alpha = 0.2,
  K = 2.0, h = 2.0,
  T_ref = 10,
  Q10_m = 2.00, Q10_a = 1.20, Q10_o = 1.50, Q10_c = 2.00
)

pO2seq <- seq(0, 30, by = 0.2)
```

## 1) Test diagnostics (single mass and temperature): pO2 vs prey index

```{r test-diagnostics-data}
m_test <- 1e4
T_test <- 5
f_seq <- seq(0.01, 0.99, by = 0.01)

d_test <- compute_state_surface(
  tr = tr,
  masses = m_test,
  Tseq = T_test,
  pO2seq = pO2seq,
  preys = f_seq,
  prey_units = "prey_index",
  pair_mode = "cross",
  progress = TRUE
) %>%
  add_masks() %>%
  mutate(
    M_m_norm = M_m / Cmax,
    M_act_norm = M_act / Cmax,
    D_SDA_norm = D_SDA / Cmax,
    Assim_norm = consump / Cmax
  )
```

```{r test-available-energy}
plot_masked(d_test, "f_ref", "pO2", "E_net_norm", "blue", "E/Cmax") +
  labs(title = "Available energy", x = "Prey index", y = expression("Oxygen,"~p[O[2]]~" (kPa)"))
```

```{r test-cruising-speed}
plot_masked(d_test, "f_ref", "pO2", "U_opt", "viridis", "U*") +
  labs(title = "Cruising speed", x = "Prey index", y = expression("Oxygen,"~p[O[2]]~" (kPa)"))
```

```{r test-food-limitation}
plot_masked(d_test, "f_ref", "pO2", "f", "green", "f", limits = c(0,1)) +
  labs(title = "Food limitation metric", x = "Prey index", y = expression("Oxygen,"~p[O[2]]~" (kPa)"))
```

```{r test-oxygen-limitation}
plot_masked(d_test, "f_ref", "pO2", "g", "purple", "g", limits = c(0,1)) +
  labs(title = "Oxygen limitation metric", x = "Prey index", y = expression("Oxygen,"~p[O[2]]~" (kPa)"))
```

```{r test-process-maintenance}
plot_masked(d_test, "f_ref", "pO2", "M_m_norm", "red", "Mm/Cmax") +
  labs(title = "Maintenance", x = "Prey index", y = expression("Oxygen,"~p[O[2]]~" (kPa)"))
```

```{r test-process-activity}
plot_masked(d_test, "f_ref", "pO2", "M_act_norm", "red", "Ma/Cmax") +
  labs(title = "Activity", x = "Prey index", y = expression("Oxygen,"~p[O[2]]~" (kPa)"))
```

```{r test-process-sda}
plot_masked(d_test, "f_ref", "pO2", "D_SDA_norm", "red", "SDA/Cmax") +
  labs(title = "SDA", x = "Prey index", y = expression("Oxygen,"~p[O[2]]~" (kPa)"))
```

```{r test-process-assim}
plot_masked(d_test, "f_ref", "pO2", "Assim_norm", "blue", "Assim/Cmax") +
  labs(title = "Assimilation", x = "Prey index", y = expression("Oxygen,"~p[O[2]]~" (kPa)"))
```


## 2) pO2 vs prey density (four separate 4-panel figures)

```{r prey-density-data}
masses <- c(1e0, 1e4)
Trows <- c(5, 25)
Bseq <- seq(0.01, 5, by = 0.03)

d_prey <- compute_state_surface(
  tr = tr,
  masses = masses,
  Tseq = Trows,
  pO2seq = pO2seq,
  preys = Bseq,
  prey_units = "biomass",
  pair_mode = "cross",
  progress = TRUE
) %>%
  add_masks() %>%
  mutate(
    mass_lab = factor(mass, levels = masses, labels = c("m = 1e0 g", "m = 1e4 g")),
    T_lab = factor(T, levels = Trows, labels = c("T = 5°C", "T = 25°C"))
  )
```

```{r prey-density-E}
plot_masked(d_prey, "B_used", "pO2", "E_net_norm", "blue", "E/Cmax") +
  facet_grid2(rows = vars(T_lab), cols = vars(mass_lab)) +
  labs(title = "Available energy", x = "Prey biomass density", y = expression("Oxygen,"~p[O[2]]~" (kPa)"))
```

```{r prey-density-f}
plot_masked(d_prey, "B_used", "pO2", "f", "green", "f", limits = c(0,1)) +
  facet_grid2(rows = vars(T_lab), cols = vars(mass_lab)) +
  labs(title = "Food limitation metric", x = "Prey biomass density", y = expression("Oxygen,"~p[O[2]]~" (kPa)"))
```

```{r prey-density-g}
plot_masked(d_prey, "B_used", "pO2", "g", "purple", "g", limits = c(0,1)) +
  facet_grid2(rows = vars(T_lab), cols = vars(mass_lab)) +
  labs(title = "Oxygen limitation metric", x = "Prey biomass density", y = expression("Oxygen,"~p[O[2]]~" (kPa)"))
```

```{r prey-density-u}
plot_masked(d_prey, "B_used", "pO2", "U_opt", "viridis", "U*") +
  facet_grid2(rows = vars(T_lab), cols = vars(mass_lab)) +
```


## 4) Metabolic allocation (stacked, normalized by Cmax)

```{r metabolic-allocation}
mass_seq <- 10^seq(0, 4, length.out = 80)
alloc_scen <- tidyr::expand_grid(T = c(5, 25), pO2 = c(5, 20), f_ref = c(0.6, 0.9))

alloc_long <- purrr::pmap_dfr(alloc_scen, function(T, pO2, f_ref) {
  B_vec <- B_from_f(
    f_ref = rep(f_ref, length(mass_seq)),
    m = mass_seq,
    tr = tr,
    T_ref = rep(T, length(mass_seq)),
    pO2_ref = rep(pO2, length(mass_seq)),
    U_lo = 1e-5,
    U_mech = 5,
    enforce_O2_feasible = TRUE,
    D = 3
  )

  purrr::map2_dfr(mass_seq, B_vec, function(m, B) {
    st <- find_U_opt(pO2_env = pO2, T = T, m = m, prey = B, tr = tr, U_lo = 1e-5, U_mech = 5)
    tibble(
      mass = m,
      Cmax = st$Cmax,
      Maintenance = st$M_m,
      Activity = st$M_act,
      SDA = st$D_SDA,
      Assimilation = st$consump
    )
  }) %>%
    mutate(T = T, pO2 = pO2, f_ref = f_ref)
}) %>%
  mutate(scen = paste0("T=", T, "°C | pO2=", pO2, " kPa | f=", sprintf("%.1f", f_ref))) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(Maintenance, Activity, SDA, Assimilation), names_to = "Process", values_to = "value") %>%
  mutate(value_norm = value / Cmax)

alloc_palette <- c(
  Maintenance = "#b2182b",
  Activity = "#ef8a62",
  SDA = "#fddbc7",
  Assimilation = "#2166ac"
)

ggplot(alloc_long, aes(x = mass, y = value_norm, fill = Process)) +
  geom_area(position = "stack", alpha = 0.95, linewidth = 0.15, color = "white") +
  scale_x_log10(labels = label_number()) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = alloc_palette) +
  facet_wrap(~scen, ncol = 2) +
  labs(
    x = "Mass (g)",
    y = "Metabolism / Cmax",
    title = "Metabolic allocation"
  ) +
  base_theme +
  square_theme
```
